message.content:
This vertical editorial illustration, framed by a thick red border on the left, features a stylized blue-and-white face in a textured, woodcut-like style. Small gold-colored construction vehicles—excavators and dump trucks—move across the face. One excavator sits on the forehead, and another is on the left cheek. Dump trucks are scattered across the right side and bottom edge. Concentric blue circles pattern the background behind the face.

The magazine title "TEMPO" is centered at the top in large white capital letters. Smaller text above it reads "PROBLEM HAK ASASI OPERASI ANTITEROR" and "BONGKAR-PASANG PENGGAWA BUMN". Below the title, the tagline "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" appears. Large yellow text at the bottom right reads "TUAN GURU DI LADANG EMAS". Below this, smaller white text explains "KPK MENYELIDIKI DUGAAN ALIRAN DANA DIVESTASI SAHAM NEWMONT NUSA TENGGARA KE GUBERNUR NTB (2008-2018) MUHAMMAD ZAINUL MAJDI. DITENGARAI MASUK KE REKENING PRIBADI, ISTRI, DAN KERABAT DEKAT." A barcode, price, and date "17-23 SEPTEMBER 2018" are in the bottom left corner.
